root_cause.text: The `pvr_fw_trace_debugfs_init` function incorrectly passed a pointer to `fw_trace` instead of `pvr_dev` as the private data when creating the "trace_mask" debugfs file, leading to a NULL pointer dereference in `pvr_fw_trace_mask_set` when it accessed the private data.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that in `pvr_fw_trace_debugfs_init`, the private data argument for `debugfs_create_file` for "trace_mask" was changed from `fw_trace` to `pvr_dev`, which resolves the NULL pointer dereference in `pvr_fw_trace_mask_set` shown in the crash log.

commit a331631496a0af9a6f4e7e1860983afd8b1bb013
Author: Matt Coster <matt.coster@imgtec.com>
Date:   Tue Jan 13 10:16:39 2026 +0000

    drm/imagination: Simplify module parameters
    
    We had a whole load of bloaty infrastructure to deal with module parameters
    in a way that's wholly unnecessary. Strip it all back to basics to make
    adding new parameters less of a headache.
    
    Reviewed-by: Alessio Belle <alessio.belle@imgtec.com>
    Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260113-devic
bic_trace_step.reason: The commit introduces the 'trace_mask' debugfs file in `pvr_fw_trace_debugfs_init` and incorrectly passes `fw_trace` as the private data (line 501: `debugfs_create_file("trace_mask", 0600, dir, fw_trace, &pvr_fw_trace_mask_fops);`). However, the corresponding getter `pvr_fw_trace_mask_get` (line 463) and setter `pvr_fw_trace_mask_set` (line 472) treat the private data as `struct pvr_device *pvr_dev`, leading to a type mismatch and a crash when accessing `pvr_dev->fw_dev.fw_trace`.
